NSExceptionHandler.doc: The NSExceptionHandler class provides facilities for monitoring and debugging exceptional conditions in Objective-C programs. It works by installing a special uncaught exception handler via the NSSetUncaughtExceptionHandler function. Consequently, to use the services of NSExceptionHandler, you must not install your own custom uncaught exception handler.

-delegate.doc: Returns the delegate of the NSExceptionHandler object.

-exceptionHandlingMask.doc: Returns a bit mask representing the types of exceptions monitored by the receiver and its handling and logging behavior.

-exceptionHangingMask.doc: Returns a bit mask representing the types of exceptions that will halt execution for debugging.

-setDelegate:.doc: Sets the delegate of the NSExceptionHandler object.

-setExceptionHandlingMask:.doc: Sets the bit mask of constants specifying the types of exceptions monitored by the receiver and its handling and logging behavior.

-setExceptionHangingMask:.doc: Sets the bit mask of constants specifying the types of exceptions that will halt execution for debugging.
